title: feat(toggleRefinement): implement `getRenderState` and `getWidgetRenderState`
body:
This implements the `getRenderState` and `getWidgetRenderState` widget lifecycle hooks in `toggleRefinement`.

There was a lot of repercussions due to the implementation of `connectorState`, so feel free to double check.
